evals.prompt: 用 openpyxl 帮我做一个 2025 年 1-12 月的销售汇总表：A 列月份，B 列销售额（输入），C 列环比增长率，最后一行合计。给出 Python 脚本和后续检查步骤。
evals.expected_output: An openpyxl script that writes inputs and live formulas, sets number formats, then recalculates with recalc.py and checks for errors.
expectations: Writes totals and growth as Excel formulas such as =SUM(...) rather than values computed in Python
Sets a percentage number_format on the growth formulas
Guards the growth formula against a zero or empty previous month
Runs scripts/recalc.py after saving and treats errors_found as not done
Uses a professional font such as Arial

evals.prompt: In my budget.xlsx I need a lookup of each department's headcount from the 'Staff List' sheet into the Summary sheet. Which formula should I write with openpyxl so that it verifies cleanly?
evals.expected_output: INDEX/MATCH with a quoted sheet name, not XLOOKUP, followed by recalc verification.
expectations: Uses INDEX and MATCH (or another Excel-2007-era function) rather than XLOOKUP
Quotes the sheet name containing a space, as in 'Staff List'!
Says to recalculate with recalc.py and check the result values, not only the absence of errors

evals.prompt: 我有一个别人做好的财务模型 model.xlsx，想同时拿到每个单元格的公式和计算结果用来审阅，代码怎么写？千万别破坏原文件。
evals.expected_output: Two load_workbook passes (default and data_only=True) and never saving the data_only workbook.
expectations: Loads the workbook twice: once for formulas and once with data_only=True for cached values
Warns that saving the data_only=True workbook would replace formulas with literals

evals.prompt: Build a three-year revenue projection sheet: growth rate assumption 12%, base revenue $4.2mm. Follow normal financial-model conventions.
evals.expected_output: A model with the assumption in its own labeled input cell referenced by formulas, blue inputs, black formulas, and $ and % formats.
expectations: Places the 12% growth assumption in its own labeled cell and references it (for example $B$3) instead of hardcoding 1.12
Colors hardcoded inputs blue and formulas black
Stores the percentage as 0.12 with a 0.0% format
Writes years as text labels and uses a currency format with the unit in the header

evals.prompt: 这个表 orders.xlsx 里有个合并单元格 A1:D1 是标题，我想把标题改成『2025 订单明细』，用 openpyxl 怎么改？
evals.expected_output: Write the new title to the top-left anchor A1 of the merged range only.
expectations: Writes only to the top-left anchor cell A1 of the merged range
Explains that the other cells of the merged range are read-only MergedCell objects
Keeps the existing formatting and formulas of the file untouched
